Posted August 1
Gift wrapping has been offered at our two stores for years. It can now be added to any order for delivery as well. For delivery orders, the charge is two dollars for each item wrapped, the same as in our stores. To mark the new service, we have also added two paper designs, bringing the choice to six.
How to add wrapping
1. On the order page, mark the box beside each item to be wrapped.
2. Pick your paper on the wrapping page, where all six designs are shown together.
3. Type your greeting in the message box. We print up to 100 letters on the card.
4. Check the full amount on the payment page before you confirm.
Tell us what you think: a feedback form follows every wrapped order.

Order number: 30947

Choosing the wrapping was easy, and the parcel arrived on the day promised. Pricing was harder to judge. The wrapping charge did not appear until the payment page, after I had already made all my choices, so I could not see what I was paying for as I went. Calvin Lockhart
Girton Building

Phased Start	Gradual change across floors	Next quarter	Low	Cannot begin until the new rate period.
